title: Ramsey number R(10,14), lower bound
statement: Find a two-colouring of the edges of K_n with no red K_10 and no blue K_14; it shows R(10,14) > n. The best known lower bound is R(10,14) >= 955, so a colouring of K_954 exists (built by the construction behind the survey's inequality; none is printed) and one of K_955 or more would improve it.
submission: Text file: the n x n adjacency matrix of the red graph, one line of n characters 0/1 per vertex (1 red, 0 blue), symmetric with a zero diagonal; n <= 2048.
score: n, the number of vertices of the colouring; it proves R(10,14) >= n + 1 (larger is better)

best_known.source: R(10,14) >= 955: implied by item 2.3.h of the survey, R(k,p+q-1) >= R(k,p) + R(k,q) + k - 2 for k >= 5, with R(10,5) >= 149 and R(10,10) >= 798; Small Ramsey Numbers rev. 18 (24 Apr 2026) printed blank in Table Ia; read 8 Nov 2026

provenance.keeper: Small Ramsey Numbers (S. Radziszowski), EJC Dynamic Survey DS1
provenance.holder: implied by the survey's inequalities (no colouring is printed)
